name: Four Seasons Resort Tamarindo
positioning: Secluded resort within a 3,000-acre private nature reserve on a peninsula in Jalisco, Mexico
best_for: Travelers who want a secluded beach resort inside a private nature reserve
Guests who want an 18-hole golf course and a Spa on site

facts.text: Four Seasons Resort Tamarindo opened in November 2022.
The resort sits within a 3,000-acre private nature reserve.
The resort is in the state of Jalisco, Mexico.
The reserve is on a secluded peninsula between the towns of La Manzanilla and Barra de Navidad.
Three levels of infinity pools cascade down the cliffside.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
El Tamarindo Golf Course is an 18-hole, par-72 course.
Sal is a restaurant perched above Majahua Beach.
Nacho is a taqueria steps from one of the resort's pools.
Manzanillo-Costalegre International Airport (ZLO) welcomes direct commercial flights daily from Mexico City.

highlights.text: Four Seasons Resort Tamarindo was recognized as the Top Resort in Mexico in the Travel & Leisure World's Best Awards 2026.
Each Cliffside Panoramic One-Bedroom Suite features its own 13-metre (43-foot) infinity swimming pool.
Coyul is run in partnership with Elena Reygadas, The World's Best Female Chef 2023.
Rancho Lola is a 14-hectare (35-acre) low-impact farm at the resort.
The Spa offers a traditional Mexican Temazcal ceremony.
Dogs and cats of all sizes can stay at the resort at no additional cost.

considerations.text: The resort says its secluded location means it is about an hour away from the nearest drugstore.
The summer months bring rain to the resort's private reserve.
Manzanillo-Costalegre International Airport (ZLO) welcomes direct commercial flights weekly from Los Angeles and Houston.
WhataHotel notes a remote location requiring extended travel time.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
